Different follow-up modalities may play a role in diagnosing asymptomatic endometrial cancer relapses. While our study found that follow-up after endometrial cancer treatment varies in Italy, it is essential to consider various methods for detecting recurrence. Some of these include:

- Ultrasound: As mentioned earlier, this imaging technique can help detect cancer in non-enhanced MR images.
- Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI): DW imaging may be helpful in detecting uterine endometrial cancer that has not been detected by conventional MRI.

It is crucial to note that the optimal approach for follow-up and diagnosis of asymptomatic endometrial cancer relapses is still unknown, and more research is needed to establish guidelines comparing various protocols.
